summary: Douglas County, OR: 1923 cabin, 1935 L-5 cab, removed or destroyed in 1966; no source found that describes the site today.

facts.design: L-5 cab, described as a 10 x 10 ground cabin
facts.status_note: Cab removed (firetower.org) or destroyed (firelookout.com) in 1966; no source describes the site today
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Willamette National Forest

events.note: Newspaper item: work to start soon on a line to the peak, where a secondary lookout was to be established
Firetower.org says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed

evidence.supports: cabin built 1923, replaced by L-5 cab in 1935, removed 1966
evidence.quote: A cabin built here in 1923 was replaced with an L-5 cab in 1935, which was removed in 1966.

evidence.supports: administered by the U.S. Forest Service

evidence.quote: Established with a cabin in 1923, an L-5 cab, built in 1935, was destroyed in 1966.

evidence.supports: 1928 newspaper item on a line and a secondary lookout
evidence.quote: Work will start soon on a line to Hills peak where a secondary lookout will be established.
August 22, 1933: Panorama photos taken by William Birchall and James Rittenhouse.
A 10 x 10 L-5 Aladdin lookout ground cabin constructed.

evidence.supports: site listed as removed, no date

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firetower.org says the cab was removed in 1966; firelookout.com says it was destroyed in 1966. The year agrees, so the event is recorded as 1966 and the verb is reported as a disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Brief coordinates, elevation (1,843 m) and L-5 design match firetower.org; no correction needed. Three sources agree on 1923 cabin, 1935 L-5 cab and 1966 removal. The 1928 secondary lookout is a newspaper plan; no source confirms it was built, so it is not recorded as an event. Searched firetower, firelookout.com, Rex's page and one web search: nothing describes the site today, so access is left out of facts. No photos with image URLs were recorded as new finds.
